title: Establish sources of truth and a short restart workflow
acceptance: README locates status, tasks and architecture | STATUS distinguishes delivered, planned and unverified work | AGENTS is self-contained without chat history
verification: Check links and read through the restart workflow

title: Structure the backlog and its automated validation
acceptance: Every ticket has steps, criteria, verification and role | Acyclic graph with no unknown dependency | Generated views match JSON
verification: Validator tests: cycle, duplicate, done without evidence, incomplete dependency

title: Choose the logo and formalize brand guidelines
acceptance: Canonical logo and provenance available | Text pairs meet 4.5:1 | Reduced motion planned without losing functionality
verification: Calculated contrasts | Review the four variants and lockup

title: Install the frontend foundation and shared commands
acceptance: npm ci then build succeed under the documented runtime | No secrets required for the foundation | Workshop identified as development, not a delivered course
verification: Typecheck and build | Desktop/mobile browser smoke and reduced motion

title: Prepare CI, quality and free delivery
acceptance: CI includes docs, tests, lint, typecheck and build | No unconfigured automatic deployment | Free-plan costs and limits sourced and dated
verification: Run CI commands locally | Review provider procedure

title: Install foundations in the repository and hand off
acceptance: Original PDFs and variants retained | Files can be tracked in git; secrets ignored | STATUS names next task and limitations; no invented remote
verification: Compare before/after manifest | git status and repeat validation

title: Translate project documentation into English and define the code comment language
acceptance: Maintained documentation and regenerated backlog views are in English. | All archived source PDFs have linked English text translations. | AGENTS and CONTRIBUTING explicitly require code comments in English. | The French launch interface and source archive provenance are preserved.
verification: Run npm run verify. | Check generated view consistency, local links and remaining French documentation text. | Compare source archive hashes before and after translation.

title: Define the free course and its professional outcome
acceptance: A beginner understands what they will be able to do | Plan includes observable criteria and worked solution | Author and reviewer identified before publication
verification: Review scenario and manually perform the task

title: Create the versioned public content schema
acceptance: Invalid content fails the build with a precise path | Stable IDs and explicit version | Arbitrary HTML and dangerous URLs rejected
verification: Valid/invalid fixtures and rejected javascript link

title: Produce and review the complete free course
acceptance: Every lesson has an objective, example, exercise and worked solution | Sources/licenses recorded and reviewer identified | No paid or private content included in build
verification: Human review | Full walkthrough by someone not involved in writing

title: Build accessible course components
acceptance: Visible focus and complete keyboard journey | 44 px touch controls; no dependence on color alone | Loading/empty/error states documented
verification: Playwright keyboard and axe | 360 px and 200% zoom review

title: Integrate local fonts and final assets
acceptance: No Google Fonts request needed | Font-display swap; legible fallback | Logo recognizable at 24/32 px and no visible CLS
verification: Network inspection and screenshot comparison

title: Deliver indexable home, catalogue and course pages
acceptance: Direct URLs and refresh work | No price for undefined offers; free clearly indicated | Initial HTML contains course title and description; consistent sitemap and 404
verification: Navigation/deep link/404 E2E | Inspect HTML without JS

title: Prepare French and future localization
acceptance: No misleading English selector | Dates and amounts through Intl; explicit timezone | Long text remains readable
verification: XAF/date format tests and pseudo-localization

title: Create the lesson reader
acceptance: Accessible text, links and illustrations | Missing lesson displays help and a way back | No heavy media starts automatically
verification: Full keyboard course E2E | Slow network and unavailable image

title: Enable practice and self-assessment
acceptance: Self-assessment clearly named | Reading alone does not validate competence | Response and exercise usable without registration
verification: Attempt/retry/solution E2E | Semantic review of results

title: Save reading progress with local consent
acceptance: No persisted progress without opt-in | Reload resumes after consent; erasure removes data | Denied/corrupt storage does not break reading; no deliverable retained
verification: Opt-in/refusal/reload/clear/incompatible-version tests

title: Add help, privacy and real feedback
acceptance: No fictional address or form | User understands local retention and host logs | Feedback requests no sensitive document or unnecessary data
verification: Actually test the support channel | Review notice and erasure

title: Optimize slow networks, public PWA and motion
acceptance: Cache limited to assets and explicitly public courses | Honest offline state; new version offered without losing reading progress | No essential effect or autoplay; initial JS target ≤250 KiB gzip
verification: Offline/update/reduced-motion E2E | Network and build-size measurements

title: Run acceptance testing with real testers
acceptance: Course can be completed from start to finish | No unresolved critical or serious accessibility defect | Observed results and limitations recorded without invented figures
verification: M0 report with devices, scenarios and fixes

title: Publish M0 for free and test rollback
acceptance: Public HTTPS URL and deep links work | Headers and CSP verified remotely | Free quotas and version/URL/support recorded; actual rollback succeeds
verification: Production smoke and return to previous version

title: Initialize PostgreSQL, migrations and local environment
acceptance: Reproducible reset from scratch | Nonpublic tables inaccessible anonymously | Separate secrets; migration applied once
verification: SQL reset integration and per-role permissions

title: Create Hono API, OpenAPI and same-origin routing
acceptance: Unknown /v1 route returns JSON 404, not SPA | Validated OpenAPI schemas and errors without stack | Worker preview contains frontend and API; no incompatible Node runtime dependency
verification: Contract tests and local/staging Worker smoke

title: Configure provider email, identity and MFA
acceptance: External tester actually receives emails before public opening | Quotas and sender domain recorded | Explicit closed-invitation mode if SMTP unavailable
verification: External inbox and unauthorized redirect tests

title: Implement BFF sessions, rotation and CSRF protection
acceptance: No refresh token accessible to JS | Logout and role change actually revoke access | Hostile origin rejected; multiple-tab refresh retains a valid session | bcrypt/Argon2id deviation accepted or adapter replaced before real accounts
verification: Rotation, expiry, CSRF, multiple-tab and cookie-flag tests

title: Implement authorization and resource isolation
acceptance: Deny by default; roles not user-editable | User B cannot read/modify any of A's data | Direct RPC calls do not bypass checks
verification: Hostile API/DB/storage matrix and IDOR tests

title: Log actions and limit abuse
acceptance: Audit immutable for ordinary business roles | Brute force and large payloads limited | Logs contain no passwords, tokens or deliverables
verification: Rate-limit, payload-size tests and log inspection

title: Build account and recovery screens
acceptance: Reset does not reveal existing accounts | Return URL must be authorized | Expired session guides reconnection without disclosure
verification: Registration, verification, reset, logout and network-error E2E

title: Import catalogue and public versions into the database
acceptance: Same content retains IDs | Drafts never accessible publicly | Referenced levels cannot be deleted; archiving preserves authorized access
verification: Repeated migration without duplicates | State and FK tests

title: Create learner area and synchronized progress
acceptance: Two devices recover progress | Idempotent import, revocable before confirmation | Imported reading creates no validated competence
verification: Two-session and version-conflict E2E

title: Create course drafts and level management
acceptance: Learners cannot edit | Concurrent save returns an explicit conflict | Editing does not modify published versions
verification: Permission, If-Match and immutability tests

title: Implement review, publication and archiving
acceptance: Publication requires validation and authorized role | Published correction creates a new version | Archiving removes sale without breaking existing entitlements
verification: Transition tests and before/after snapshot

title: Manage private media and controlled uploads
acceptance: Out-of-scope users retrieve neither files nor metadata | Rejected/quarantined content not served | Expired tokens and misleading types rejected
verification: Malicious upload, size, expiry and cross-account access tests

title: Version exercises, criteria and rubrics
acceptance: Published exercise references an immutable rubric | Missed critical criterion blocks milestone | New rubric displayed before a new submission
verification: Tests where threshold is met but a critical criterion is missing

title: Submit and resume an exercise
acceptance: Submission freezes ExerciseVersion and RubricVersion | Retry does not create two submissions | Local draft for nonsensitive text only after opt-in; no private attachment queue
verification: Network interruption, conflict, retry and revocation E2E

title: Review work and request revision
acceptance: Only assigned trainer may review | REWORK retains the cycle rubric | Timestamped decision and appeal; reading alone never yields PASS
verification: Review/rework/appeal E2E and out-of-cohort access

title: Present a course in presentation mode
acceptance: No private grade/submission/message projected | Same content/version as reader | Usable when full-screen mode is denied
verification: Presentation E2E and inspection for absence of private data

title: Create support and notification inbox
acceptance: Users see only their own tickets | Important events available without email | Support does not implicitly receive financial documents
verification: Isolation and email-channel failure tests

title: Handle deletion, export and retention
acceptance: Authenticated request and processing trace | Deletion revokes sessions and files under policy | Legitimate retention separate and explained; no future financial hard delete
verification: Impersonated request, deletion and cross-account export tests

title: Back up and restore database and files
acceptance: Backup does not reside in git | Files restored in addition to SQL | Time/loss measured, owner and frequency recorded
verification: Restoration drill checking accounts/content/files

title: Test account security and accessibility
acceptance: No open critical/high vulnerability at release | Every exception has an owner and planned fix | Authenticated axe test and manual review recorded
verification: Security/ASVS report and account→exercise→review E2E

title: Measure free-backend load and cost
acceptance: Test profile and region recorded | Sessions/auth fit runtime budget | Overrun plan triggers no automatic payment
verification: Gradual load with fictional data and documented costs

title: Configure environments, secrets and alerts
acceptance: Preview does not read production data | Rotatable secrets never in build/logs | Alert received and owner named
verification: Bundle leak test and simulated outage

title: Deliver the free pilot with accounts
acceptance: External tester completes registration and exercise | Public registration closed if SMTP missing | Migration-compatible rollback tested; URL/version recorded
verification: Production smoke and restoration/revocation scenario

title: Formalize commercial policies and operators
acceptance: Prices/terms approved by named owners | Two finance people available | No-slot and late-payment cases have a customer procedure
verification: Written review of business scenarios

title: Model versioned offers and distinct entitlements
acceptance: Price set by offer, not level | Future change has no effect on existing order | Beneficiary, payer and buyer distinct
verification: Snapshot and per-component entitlement tests

title: Create idempotent orders and expiry
acceptance: Double click creates one order | Same key with different payload returns 409 | Expiry prevents new instructions but retains late transfers for resolution
verification: Clock, replay, different-payload and integer-XAF tests

title: Upload and review payment evidence
acceptance: Screenshot alone grants no entitlement | Rejecting an image does not declare funds unreceived | Actual type, limits and malware handling documented and tested
verification: AT-PAY-01 and malicious/cross-account document test

title: Record transactions and allocations
acceptance: Duplicate reference rejected in DB | No allocation exceeds available amount | Integer amounts and discrepancies without implicit tolerance
verification: AT-PAY-03 and identical-reference concurrency

title: Build independent reconciliation and dual approval
acceptance: Same maker/checker rejected on server | No confirmation without second verifier | Approval traces actor, source and decision; no implicit support role
verification: AT-PAY-02 and missing-MFA/revoked-role/missing-source tests

title: Activate entitlements in the financial transaction
acceptance: Entitlement creation error rolls back confirmation | Confirmed payment opens reading even without a session | Retry duplicates neither entitlements nor credits
verification: AT-ENT-01 and injected transaction rollback

title: Deliver outbox, retries and idempotent notifications
acceptance: Crash after commit resumes without duplicate entitlement | Unique logical notification despite repeated delivery | Payload without secrets or documents; entitlements rechecked at rendering
verification: AT-DATA-01, crash/replay/concurrent worker

title: Handle discrepancies, delays, disputes and refunds
acceptance: Late transfer retained without automatic entitlement | Auditable refund and reversal with dual control | Customer sees state and next contractual step
verification: AT-PAY-04 and partial/excess/reversal cases

title: Open schedule and resources
acceptance: Only authorized role opens a slot | UTC stored, Africa/Douala displayed | Past/closed slots never bookable; travel included
verification: Timezone, closure and resource-collision tests

title: Atomically book a seat in Mode A
acceptance: Only one booking wins the last seat | Credit consumed at most once | Role/entitlement/capacity rechecked at commit, never only against displayed availability
verification: AT-BOOK-01 with real PostgreSQL concurrency

title: Build the learner booking journey
acceptance: 409 explains conflict and offers another seat | No slot: reading retained and AWAITING_SLOT | Button does not promise a booking before confirmation
verification: Confirmed-payment→booking E2E and UI concurrency

title: Handle rescheduling, cancellations, absence and replacement
acceptance: Repeated cancellation does not restore credit twice | Absent trainer does not mark a session held | Replacement/rescheduling records decision and notifies
verification: AT-BOOK-04 and concurrent cancellations

title: Send reminders and track assignment deadlines
acceptance: Rescheduling cancels old reminders | Replayed reminder not logically duplicated | Exceeded deadline alerts the identified owner
verification: AT-NOT-01 and clock/weekend/worker-outage tests

title: Define invoices, credit notes and numbering rules
acceptance: Issuer and required information approved by tax owner | Preview clearly marked unissued | Issuance permission separate from entry
verification: Finance review and approved tax scenarios

title: Issue an immutable invoice with an atomic number
acceptance: Two issuances never share a number | Retry returns the same document | Issued document cannot be modified/deleted; gaps explained without reuse
verification: Concurrency, idempotency and update/delete prohibition tests

title: Generate private PDF and print preview
acceptance: PDF matches issued snapshot | Expired/cross-account URL rejected | CPU/memory/generation verified on runtime; separate adapter if quota exceeded
verification: Amount/date/number content comparison and actual runtime test

title: Issue credit notes and check accounting reconciliation
acceptance: Correction preserves original | Sensitive permissions and MFA verified | Issuance/receipt discrepancy visible and traceable
verification: Authorized full/partial credit-note tests and account checks

title: Create organizations, memberships and cohorts
acceptance: A person can belong to two organizations without leaks | Revoked membership cuts relevant access | Coordinator does not receive grades/documents by default
verification: AT-SEC-01 on search, list, detail and files

title: Allocate seats and expiring invitations
acceptance: One seat cannot have two active beneficiaries | Expired/revoked invitation rejected | Reinvitation and reallocation follow policy and audit
verification: Last-seat concurrency and token replay tests

title: Display authorized B2B progress
acceptance: Cell of 3 suppressed under proposed threshold of 5 | Totals/filters do not allow trivial inference | Individual data stays closed without approved permission/purpose
verification: AT-ORG-01 with small groups and filter differences

title: Produce the first complete paid C1 course
acceptance: Distinct author and reviewer recorded | Every competency has a deliverable and rubric | No sale of an incomplete course presented as complete
verification: Full educational acceptance testing and review consistency

title: Issue a certificate based on competencies
acceptance: Attendance/reading alone insufficient | Missing critical criterion blocks issuance | Document name does not imply unestablished accredited certification
verification: Satisfied-criteria/missing-critical/version/revocation tests

title: Manage sensitive permissions and separation of duties
acceptance: Admin cannot self-confirm a payment | Role change logged and effective on server | Support/scheduler do not implicitly gain finance privileges
verification: Role matrix and metadata-escalation tests

title: Finalize operations, retention and applicable compliance
acceptance: Applicable DEC-03 to DEC-08 decisions recorded | Named owners and verified channels | Proposed deadlines not presented as unapproved commitments
verification: Operational review and documented business validation

title: Run concurrent finance and booking acceptance tests
acceptance: No overbooking or entitlement without confirmation | Zero financial self-approval | Consistent DB/API/audit/outbox evidence
verification: AT-PAY-01..04, AT-BOOK-01/04, AT-ENT-01, AT-DATA-01

title: Test privacy, accessibility and private cache
acceptance: No private data in public cache, URL or presentation | Access controls tested on media/exports | Commercial journeys usable with keyboard and screen reader
verification: AT-SEC-01, AT-ORG-01, AT-PRES-01 and AT-UX-01

title: Test pilot restoration, load and budget
acceptance: RPO/RTO measured and accepted | Target booking p95 <1.5 s documented with context; nominal 5xx <1% | Quota threshold and fallback plan decided before sales
verification: AT-PERF-01 and restoration drill with evidence

title: Launch and observe the commercial pilot
acceptance: Free/C1 courses ready and product decisions approved | Rollback and support ready; URL/commit/version recorded | Mode B/PSP/forums/AI import stay closed; weekly monitoring established
verification: Real smoke without fictional payment presented as real | Metrics and incident review

title: Define forum moderation and scopes
acceptance: Owner and deadlines named | Scope membership required | Activation prohibited without moderation capacity
verification: Policy review and access matrix

title: Build isolated forums and authorized search
acceptance: Outside cohort no private thread/metadata | Traceable reporting and appeals | Index does not expose private content to public
verification: AT-COM-01 and cross-scope search tests

title: Import safe, structured AI drafts
acceptance: AI limited to drafts with bounded token | XSS/SSRF/oversized payloads rejected | Connector cannot publish, pay or grant permissions
verification: AT-AI-01 and hostile corpus

title: Deliver interface and first course in English
acceptance: Missing keys fall back cleanly to FR | No mixing of nonequivalent rubrics | Journey and layout tested by English speakers
verification: FR/EN E2E and human review

title: Add alternative authentication and account linking
acceptance: No account merge based on unverified email | Consistent revocation/logout | Email journey keeps working
verification: Takeover, duplicate and callback-CSRF tests

title: Add consented push notifications
acceptance: No detailed financial notifications on lock screen | Refusal does not block usage | Information remains in account without push
verification: Refusal, logout, expired-subscription and duplicate tests

title: Improve search and explainable recommendations
acceptance: Search respects publication/entitlements | Recommendation without implicit sensitive profiling | Success measurement with consent and before/after comparison
verification: Private search tests and user interviews

title: Create a portfolio of evidence with controlled sharing
acceptance: Private by default | Revocation cuts link with appropriate cache handling | No sensitive employer/customer data published by default
verification: Consent, expiry and post-revocation access tests

title: Validate then implement Mode B options
acceptance: Mode frozen on order | Timely evidence retains capacity until an explicit bound | Expired hold never reactivated; justified/audited extensions
verification: AT-BOOK-02/03 and capacity/expiry concurrency

title: Integrate PSP and verified webhooks
acceptance: Duplicate webhook duplicates neither payment nor entitlement | Invalid signature and out-of-window timestamp rejected | Refund/reversal and verifiable source handled
verification: Provider sandbox tests and out-of-order replay

title: Define and deliver payment schedules
acceptance: Entitlements follow approved policy | Installment total matches order | Late payment/regularization/refund explicit
verification: Due-date and out-of-order payment tests

title: Study and secure offline private content
acceptance: Expired/revoked entitlement handled under published policy | Logout/erasure clears private cache | No promise of instant revocation without network
verification: Offline, clock, account-switch and erasure tests

title: Size media and real-time services from measurements
acceptance: Controlled, nonindexable media URLs | SSE rechecks entitlements and bounds resume | Egress budget and adaptive quality measured
verification: Media/SSE load and revocation during active connection

title: Test scaling and possible service separation
acceptance: No 1M promise without demonstrated test profile | Finance/capacity invariants preserved under load | New separation justified by ADR and migration plan
verification: Reproducible benchmarks and failure tests
